faq.title: Frequently
faq.q1: Does the software work for all PCs?
faq.a1: Yes! All configurations are supported, from entry-level to high-end setups. Each module automatically detects your hardware (Intel/AMD, NVIDIA/AMD) and adapts the optimizations.
faq.a2: No. The 100+ optimizations are safe and reversible. A Windows restore point is automatically created before each change. One click to roll back.
faq.q3: How long does it take to apply everything?
faq.a3: Less than 5 minutes. The software automatically applies all 100+ tweaks. You can also enable modules one by one based on your needs.
faq.a4: Absolutely. The GPU module detects your card and applies optimal settings: Low Latency Mode, NVIDIA Reflex, Anti-Lag (RTX 2000/3000/4000, RX 6000/7000).
faq.a5: Yes, the software updates automatically with new Fortnite optimizations, driver updates and meta changes. Always included.
